# popMind

> popMind is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) macOS app for Apple silicon Macs (macOS 12 or later) that acts on the text you select in any app: translate it, have AI explain it and ask follow-ups, copy it, or hand it to ChatGPT, Grok, Perplexity or Google. It also has a ⌥Space launcher (apps, math, /tr, -ai, /ex) and a ⌥V clipboard history. AI features use your own API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Kimi, DeepSeek, custom relays, local Gemma). Chinese name: popMind（macOS 划词 AI 工具）. Current version: 0.9.0.

- Website: https://pm.luckysnail.cn/en (English), https://pm.luckysnail.cn/zh (简体中文)
- Download (latest, 6.5 MB disk image): https://github.com/coderPerseus/popMind/releases/latest/download/popMind-arm64.dmg
- Source code: https://github.com/coderPerseus/popMind
- Releases and changelog: https://github.com/coderPerseus/popMind/releases
